title: Content Pool: Bali Healing
subtitle: Homepage first. Existing site, 58 pages. Integrative clinic in Canggu for expats and visitors. No HWG: client rules and Google health policy apply.

findings.text: The homepage is below the competitor floor. It has {bench.own} words. The floor from gate A0 is {bench.floor} words (70 % of the median {bench.median} words of {bench.n} clinic homepages). It shows no team, no price, no FAQ and no phone number. It carries the same H1 twice.

Skin tag, wart and mole removal is the clearest real demand. Search Console shows {CP-SVC-001.gsc_impr} impressions and {CP-SVC-001.gsc_clicks} clicks in 90 days. The client moved its ads focus here on 27 August. The page has 740 words and states no price.

IV drip is the biggest service search and the clinic is invisible for it. "iv drip bali" has 1,300 searches a month. The Maps top-3 share is 0 percent. {CP-SVC-004.cov} clinic sites have an IV drip page. The clinic page says "infusions" and one page is set to noindex.

Ozone is falling. The Maps top-3 share fell from 57.1 to 34.7 percent in 14 days. The market leader holds the Medical clinic category, which the main profile lacks. The site has four ozone pages and no price. Searches: "ozone therapy" 720, "ozone therapy bali" 210.

Price is the common gap. None of the 58 own pages names a price. Only {CP-SVC-005.cov} competitor sites show one. People search for cost: "skin tag removal bali price", "iv drip bali cost", "acupuncture bali price".

Brand search carries the site. Brand queries bring {gsc.brand_impr} of {gsc.listed_impr} listed impressions ({gsc.brand_share}). Many other "healing" queries (retreat, spa, screaming therapy, sound healing) have no matching service. They need a client decision.

Large volumes are traps. "bali belly symptoms" has 4,400 searches, "colonic hydrotherapy bali" 140. Naturopathy and live blood analysis were given up by the client on 30 July, but pages and profile still show them. Maps shows 71.4 percent for naturopath.

Trust needs real names. The pages show no doctor, no licence and no team section. This is the most sensitive item because of the licence question for foreign practitioners. Reviews are good (4.7 with 100) but no review has an owner reply.

Data limits. Three competitor sites could not be read: baliozonetherapy.com and bodhicittaacupuncture.com do not resolve, and osteocanggu.com shows a maintenance page. thedosebali.com blocks readers (403). Claims about the ozone and acupuncture leaders carry this caveat. The Maps numbers come from the client audit of 11 October. Nothing was rescanned.

pillars.location: Hero and title with Canggu and the service words, one H1. A location block with address, hours, WhatsApp, parking and access. Areas named in text, no area pages (one address). Fix the entity data: structured data, Apple Maps, one name everywhere.
pillars.service: Twenty service groups on the site. Lead with skin tag and mole removal, IV drip, ozone and acupuncture. Give every treatment page a price range, steps and a doctor-checked FAQ. Re-open the IV and acupuncture pages. Naturopathy, live blood analysis and detox stay out.
pillars.brand: One sentence for what Bali Healing is, with two doors (Wellness and Beauty). English, WhatsApp, payment and insurance facts for expats. Voice rules: no country references, Indonesian doctors and nurses, no miracle words.
pillars.authority: Doctors and practitioners with names, licence type and photo, only with proof. Real proof strip (4.7 with 100 reviews, serving Bali since 2006). Reviews that name the treatment, with owner replies. Aftercare pages. Listings and the backlink review go to the backlink workflow.

decisions: Naturopathy and live blood analysis (CP-SVC-026): remove from site and profile, or reinstate? Pages and profile contradict the client decision of 30 July.
Adjacent items (CP-SVC-023, CP-SVC-024, CP-SVC-025): breathwork, sound healing and screaming therapy; IV home service and Bali belly; general care. Only with the client's yes.
IV and acupuncture pages are set to noindex. Confirm that this is a mistake before the pool targets them.
Doctors and licences (CP-AUT-001): the client must give names, licence type and photos. No title without proof.
Price ranges (CP-SVC-005): the client must give the prices. Without them the pages stay drafts.
Is the third Google profile "Bali ThetaHealing" the client's own? Its website is balihealing.com.
Is EBOO the same as the hyperbaric major autohemotherapy? The query "eboo bali" brings visits.
